The resumption ends hopes for a lasting ceasefire in what sources describe as the worst fighting in years between the neighbors. Taliban sources claimed over 400 casualties from previous Pakistani airstrikes, while Pakistan rejected these figures and stated it was targeting military installations and terrorist infrastructure.
